archetypes.name: scout-normalizer
archetypes.rationale: Step 2 now delegates scout filtering to a shared wrapper.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 2 scout sidecar normalization path. Focus on wrapper status parsing, same-path input/output behavior, and failure fallback to an empty manifest Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: stdout-envelope
archetypes.rationale: Wrapper stdout must not leak into dispatcher KVs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that wrapper-owned WARN and SCOUT_* lines stay captured and cannot contaminate the Step 2 dispatcher stdout envelope across complete, empty, and parse-failed paths Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
